name: Playtest lens — play the compiled case in the lab
problemStatement: The lab has a Playtest lens next to Script and Canvas that loads any compiled case: first a content display where every emitted entity renders in its player surface, then a playable loop probe answers whether the authored content plays
body:
## Decisions so far

- The destination is a playable content playthrough. A read-only content display is a milestone on the way, not a separate destination. (Terje, 2026-08-09)
- The playtest surface lives as a third lens in the lab, next to Script and Canvas, over the same compiled case. (Terje, 2026-08-09)
- The playtest lens grows from the SB-055 preview rail. The preview renderers are the seed, not a parallel implementation. (Terje, 2026-08-09)
- Case-agnostic from day one: the lens renders whatever the compiler emits, not tiny-olsen specifically. (Terje, 2026-08-09)

- SB-078: the lab state is a MobX spine — shallow observable state + selection in model.ts, rebuild rides a reaction on caseText, status/worklist/inspector/highlight render via autorun. The compiler stays pure (result/graph are refs). Probe-surface mirrors exist for the smoke tests only; new panels read the observables. (wayfinder, 2026-08-09)

## Out of scope

- A second game implementation. The lab pinned rule stands: probes test design decisions faster than Godot, they never replace it. The engine-scope grill draws the exact line.
- Godot-side changes in lifelines-core-loop.
- New authored content. The map plays what the compiler already emits.
- Porting wireframes wholesale. Wireframes donate loop skeletons and render idioms, not code lineage.

comments.author: claude
comments.text:
Charting session 2026-08-09 (wayfinder). Surveyed all 48 core-loop wireframes with four research agents, grilled Terje on the destination, created the map and six tickets.

Survey shortlist (full reports in the session, key facts here):
- Slice-shaped playable loops: bestilt_papir_probe (documents/dispatches/clocks verbatim from the slice), frank_chat_r2_probe (runs/questions/frank_response in slice shape), one_desk_world_probe (full 5-min day loop, self-contained), desk_dossier_probe (document-handling loop), case_session_spike_v4/v5 (largest loops; v5 CHAT_SCRIPT gating resembles compiled weave), greybox_language_test (cleanest content/mechanics split, runtime content swap).
- Display shell idiom: lifelines_prologue_design_playground (surface + day + state-knob browser, no loop).
- Spec pages: case_ui_inventory (field checklist for every case surface), watch_panel_v2_composed (SAK/LOGG/PERSON tab spine), watch_panel_value_probe ("every row has a verb").
- Harness idiom: A/B/C variant nav + DOMSLISTE verdict form (sakskart_board, timepanel).
- Weak for this map: fridge, hjemmebesok (beats as code), phone_connector (needs per-contact lines the slice does not author), skill/HUD family (wrong domain).

Lab facts: SB-055 preview.ts already renders fact/document/question player surfaces (uncommitted, other session). CaseSlice shape lives in src/compiler/emit.ts. Olsen is hard-wired in vite caseSave(), gen:olsen, and the generated tinyOlsen.ts module.

Frontier: SB-058 (engine-scope grill) and SB-059 (case-agnostic plumbing research). SB-060 waits on SB-055 landing.
